It boasts extremely high stopping power, but its structural weakness made its low durability impractical for combat.|Inventory|TotK}} Royal Guard's Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 70 |durability = 14 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Guard's Shield}} Royal Guard's Shields are found in [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]], either abandoned or being used by the Enemies inside. They were created using the [[Ancient Technology]] of the [[Sheikah]] for use of the Royal Guards of [[Hyrule Kingdom]]. Though they have an incredibly high defense, a structural weakness led to their low [[Durability]], making them impractical for combat. This is a common feature of the [[Royal Guard's Series]], the equipment archetype to which Royal Guard's Shields belong.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} One Royal Guard's Shield can be found in the [[King's Study]], which is within Hyrule Castle's [[Library]]. If Link wears a Royal Guard's Shield while talking to [[Selmie]], she will be unimpressed to the point of yawning and calls them flimsy pieces of garbage that are worthless to serious Shield Surfers, due to their poor Durability making them unsuitable for [[Shield Surfing]].{{Cite|A royal guard's shield... *yawn* Those flimsy pieces of garbage are worthless to serious surfers.|Selmie|BotW}} As part of "[[The Royal Guard's Gear]]" [[Side Quest]], [[Parcy]] wishes to see a piece of the Royal Guard's Series.{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago. I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures. Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}} If Link speaks to her while carrying a Royal Guard's Shield, she will recognize it and ask him to show it to her.{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that shield you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}} Should Link agree, she will be grateful and give him a [[Gold Rupee]] as a reward.{{Cite|Thank you. You have shown me something truly spectacular. I need to go out and find one of these myself. Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} Afterwards, Link can trade Royal Guard's Shields with Parcy in exchange for a [[Topaz]], [[Ruby]], or [[Sapphire]].{{Cite|Hey, that shield... Will you trade it for a topaz?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, that shield... Will you trade it for a ruby?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Hey, that shield... Will you trade it for a sapphire?|Parcy|BotW}} Being made of metal, Royal Guard's Shields conduct [[Electricity]] and will attract [[Lightning]] if equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. However, they will not burn like wooden [[Shield]]s do when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in water, but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_033" |Life = 14 |GuardPower = 70 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 13 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 14 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 26 |RideBreakRatio = 3.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 70 |durability = 14 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Guard's Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Royal Guard's Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Royal Guard's Shields can be wielded by Link in conjunction with [[Royal Guard's Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Royal Guard's Series * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Royal Guard's Series, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
